newsitem.title: USA: Alumax unit president to retire.
newsitem.headline: Alumax unit president to retire.

text.p: Alumax Inc said Thursday that James Lowry, the president of its unit, Alumax Mill Products Inc, will retire on January 31.
A successor will be announced "in the near future," the company said.
Lowry joined Alumax Mill in 1972 and rose through the ranks until he was named president in 1994.

Alumax is a world leader in the production of primary aluminum ingot, billet and slab. It is also a major fabricator of aluminum products used in the transportation, building, packaging and consumer products industries.
